project.name: Provider Demo — Locally Synthesized Assets
project.objective: Prove the P3.1 provider-neutral asset production contracts: SFX, music bed and gradient image generation with receipts, rights state and core validation.

creative.concept: A five-second provider showcase where every sound and image is synthesized in-repo with a recorded provenance receipt.
creative.audience: Motion Studio producers reviewing provider-generated asset pipelines.
creative.message: Every asset carries a receipt: provider, params, hash and rights status.

scenes.name: Provider Showcase
scenes.intent: Demonstrate a generated gradient backdrop, music bed and SFX cues backed by full provider receipts.
